description: This file defines the DataProductPublishingService class, which orchestrates the workflow for data product draft submission, validation, approval, and publishing in a FastAPI-based service. It utilizes repository and protocol abstractions for draft and audit logging, and contains methods for managing approval decisions, validation runs, and drafts publication.

classes.name: DataProductPublishingService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing the workflow related to drafting, validating, approving, and publishing data products, including error handling and audit logging.

classes.name: DataProductPublishingService.GateFailure
classes.description: Exception class used to indicate failure in validation gate checks.

classes.name: DataProductPublishingService.Forbidden
classes.description: Exception class used to indicate forbidden actions such as segregation of duties violations or approval issues.

methods.name: submit_draft( self, *, actor_id: str, correlation_id: str, submission: DraftSubmissionRequest, idempotency_key: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Creates a new draft, assigns an ID, and logs the submission through audit repository.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] run_validation( self, *, actor_id: str, correlation_id: str, draft_id: str, req: ValidationRunRequest, idempotency_key: Optional[str], test_force_gate_failure: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Performs validation on a draft, including forced failure scenarios for testing, updates draft validation state, and logs the result.

methods.name: ApprovalDecision create_approval_decision( self, *, actor_id: str, correlation_id: str, draft_id: str, req: ApprovalDecisionRequest, idempotency_key: Optional[str], test_submitter_id: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Creates an approval decision, enforcing segregation of duties, re-authentication, and logs approval or failure.

methods.name: PublishResponse publish_draft( self, *, actor_id: str, correlation_id: str, draft_id: str, req: PublishRequest, idempotency_key: Optional[str], test_force_policy_decision: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Publishes a draft if approved, with options for policy overrides, and logs the publication event.
